newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish SOP sets Sept 23 pulp benchmark at $558.57.
newsitem.headline: Finnish SOP sets Sept 23 pulp benchmark at $558.57.

text.p: Suomen Optioporssi (SOP), a Finnish options exchange, on Monday put the value of northern bleached softwood pulp at $558.57 per tonne, down from $563.04 last week.
Information for calculation of the benchmark pulp price is supplied by more than 30 companies from 11 different countries, SOP says.
The benchmark Pulp Indicator Index (PIX) is released by SOP every Monday at 1200/0900 GMT. In August, the PIX average was $556.24, the exchange said.
SOP is calculating the PIX with the intention of starting trading in pulp derivatives. The start of trade in the derivatives has been postponed twice.
SOP said last Friday trading would start as soon as it had received a sufficient number of clearing accounts.
